description:
Cast Mirrormade by paying {2}{U}.
Mirrormade enters the battlefield as a copy of Oblivion Ring, triggering Sage of Mysteries and itself.
Resolve the Sage of Mysteries trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Mirrormade's trigger, exiling Oblivion Ring.
Cast Copy Enchantment by paying {2}{U}.
Copy Enchantment enters the battlefield as a copy of the Oblivion Ring copy, triggering Sage of Mysteries and itself.
Resolve the Sage of Mysteries trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Copy Enchantment's trigger, exiling Mirrormade.
Mirrormade leaves the battlefield, triggering itself, returning Oblivion Ring from exile to the battlefield.
Sage of Mysteries and Oblivion Ring trigger.
Resolve the Sage of Mysteries trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling Copy Enchantment.
Copy Enchantment leaves the battlefield, returning Mirrormade from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 until each opponent has an empty library, then end the loop by choosing to copy or exile any other permanent.
